name: NORI 128 GB clean-install USB capacity budget
notes: 128 GB means decimal manufacturer capacity, approximately 119.21 GiB.
Keep 32 GB as conservative installer-media headroom; this is not the installed user's memory/database allocation.
Allow another 4 GB for filesystem metadata, boot partitions and unmodeled overhead.
Select the complete clean installer, essential application/runtime and qualified starter model payload explicitly; not the developer workspace or every available model.
Never include existing owner credentials, identity keys, conversations, personal files, memories or populated user databases. Provision fresh owner state on the installed device.
Capacity approval does not certify a complete runtime, bootability, portability or hardware support.
